title: SPARTACUS - Spatial Climate Observation Dataset for Austria - Version 3

parameters.name: RR
parameters.desc: monthly sum (derived from daily sums between 07:00 UTC+1 of the respective day and 07:00 UTC+1 of the following day)

parameters.name: RRa_1961_1990
parameters.long_name: relative anomaly of monthly precipitation sum w.r.t. 1961-1990
parameters.desc: relative anomaly of monthly sum (derived from daily sums) relative to the mean of the reference period 1961-1990

parameters.name: RRa_1991_2020
parameters.long_name: relative anomaly of monthly precipitation sum w.r.t. 1991-2020
parameters.desc: relative anomaly of monthly sum (derived from daily sums) relative to the mean of the reference period 1991-2020

parameters.name: SA
parameters.desc: monthly sum (derived from daily sums measured between 00:00 UTC+1 and 24:00 UTC+1 of the respective day)

parameters.name: SAa_1961_1990
parameters.long_name: relative anomaly of monthly sunshine duration w.r.t. 1961-1990
parameters.desc: relative anomaly of monthly total sunshine duration (derived from daily sums) relative to the mean of the reference period 1961-1990

parameters.name: SAa_1991_2020
parameters.long_name: relative anomaly of monthly sunshine duration w.r.t. 1991-2020
parameters.desc: relative anomaly of monthly sum (derived from daily sums) relative to the mean of the reference period 1991-2020

parameters.name: TM
parameters.long_name: monthly mean of air temperature (average of TN and TX)
parameters.desc: monthly mean (average of TN and TX)

parameters.name: TM24
parameters.desc: monthly mean (derived from (reconstructed) daily means of hourly measurements between 01:00 UTC+1 and 24:00 UTC+1)

parameters.name: TM24a_1961_1990
parameters.long_name: anomaly of monthly air temperature mean  w.r.t. 1961-1990
parameters.desc: anomaly of monthly mean relative to the mean of the reference period 1961-1990 (derived from (reconstructed) daily means of hourly measurements between 01:00 UTC+1 and 24:00 UTC+1)

parameters.name: TM24a_1991_2020
parameters.long_name: anomaly of monthly air temperature mean  w.r.t. 1991-2020
parameters.desc: anomaly of monthly mean relative to the mean of the reference period 1991-2020 (derived from (reconstructed) daily means of hourly measurements between 01:00 UTC+1 and 24:00 UTC+1)

parameters.name: TMa_1961_1990
parameters.long_name: anomaly of monthly air temperature mean (average of TN and TX) w.r.t. 1961-1990
parameters.desc: anomaly of monthly mean relative to the mean of the reference period 1961-1990 (average of TN and TX)

parameters.name: TMa_1991_2020
parameters.long_name: anomaly of monthly air temperature mean (average of TN and TX) w.r.t. 1991-2020
parameters.desc: anomaly of monthly mean relative to the mean of the reference period 1991-2020 (average of TN and TX)

parameters.name: TN
parameters.long_name: monthly mean of daily minimum air temperature
parameters.desc: monthly mean of daily minimum (derived from daily minima measured between 19:00 UTC+1 of the previous day and 19:00 UTC+1 of the respective day)

parameters.name: TNa_1961_1990
parameters.long_name: anomaly of monthly mean daily minimum of air temperature w.r.t. 1961-1990
parameters.desc: anomaly of monthly mean daily minimum relative to the mean of the reference period 1961-1990

parameters.name: TNa_1991_2020
parameters.long_name: anomaly of monthly mean daily minimum of air temperature w.r.t. 1991-2020
parameters.desc: anomaly of monthly mean daily minimum relative to the mean of the reference period 1991-2020

parameters.name: TX
parameters.long_name: monthly mean of daily maximum air temperature
parameters.desc: monthly mean of daily maximum (derived from daily maxima measured between 19:00 UTC+1 of the previous day and 19:00 UTC+1 of the respective day)

parameters.name: TXa_1961_1990
parameters.long_name: anomaly of monthly mean daily maximum of air temperature w.r.t. 1961-1990
parameters.desc: anomaly of monthly mean daily maximum relative to the mean of the reference period 1961-1990

parameters.name: TXa_1991_2020
parameters.long_name: anomaly of monthly mean daily maximum of air temperature w.r.t. 1991-2020
parameters.desc: anomaly of monthly mean daily maximum relative to the mean of the reference period 1991-2020
